entities.name: HldE-like protein
observations: 494-aa query has 40.8–42.5% identity and 95.7–97.2% query coverage to reviewed HldE homologs; annotation is homology-supported, not direct assay of query.
Homolog annotations assign bifunctional activities in ADP-heptose biosynthesis: heptose-7-phosphate phosphorylation and heptose-1-phosphate adenylylation.

entities.name: HldE heptose-7-P kinase
observations: D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate + ATP = D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate + ADP + H(+); EC 2.7.1.167; RHEA:27473.

entities.name: HldE heptose-1-P adenylyltransferase
observations: D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate + ATP + H(+) = ADP-D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose + diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.70; RHEA:27465.
